title: Locked share, copy already gone
clue: File server FS-01 locked its finance share overnight. Leadership wants to restore from backup and ignore the note. Submit the flag that explains why a clean restore would not end this.
evidence: fs-01 audit   03:58  4,212 files renamed to *.lck in \\FS-01\finance
backup        the 01:00 snapshot of FS-01 is intact and verified
dlp           no alerts; the upload was HTTPS to an unclassified host
hints: Start with identify. The artifact's alphabet names the outer layer.
Two layers. After the first, the words keep their shape and punctuation but aren't English.
The backup is fine, so the lock alone isn't the threat. Compare when the upload ended with when the files were renamed.
